notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.content:
Bug fixes including:

- Undo button bugs on graveyard
- Riddle three not being marked as solved (the destination of the riddle has changed, so those who have discovered should go back and redo it)
- Made secret that occurs at ending of game accessible 
- Made second end-game secret accessible
- Various grammar issues

Thank you for being patient as we fix things!

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.content:
Crystals and Curses version 1.2 is up! Here are the updates:

- Undo button now undoes all moves
- Fixed Marina and Mr. Pinch animation (Where they were invisible)
- Added slightly more time to bosses
- Fixed a clone cheat
- Fixed transitions to secret content
- Fixed stars in world map
- Fixed blurry map art on Windows

If you are having trouble opening the application on Mac, try uninstalling and reinstalling. 

More about the undo button: 
We noticed that people were getting frustrated with the undo button. It was designed to undo a move if players selected the wrong crystal (especially on moving levels); rather than allow people to undo as many moves as possible. This was because we didn't want players mindlessly undoing their moves and trying new routes without putting thought into a puzzle's solution. What we are seeing, however, is that players simply retrace their path anyway, which is extremely annoying for you! We updated the undo button and it now undoes all movements. 

Thank you so much for playing our game! We hope you love it! Also be sure to explore the different parts of the game that are not explicitly shown to you, such as the ring upgrade tab in the bag and the riddles in the lore section!
